en.acp.unavailable: The ACP subsystem is temporarily unavailable. Native-only mode is active: the Current/ACP filters and ACP session options are hidden; native model selection is unaffected. Reopen this menu once it recovers.{reference}

en.cross.createFailedRestored: The new session was not created: {message}. The default model was restored.

en.default.writeError: Failed to write the default model.
en.empty.efforts: This model has no selectable reasoning efforts.
en.error.noModel: No model is available for creating a new session.

en.live.blocked: Session continuity checks failed ({cause}): the ACP context is locked and prompts will be refused.
en.live.blockedGuidance: Way out: fix the cause and restart DSH to retry; or discard the old ACP context and reopen it (button below — DSH-side history is fully preserved); or start a new session.
en.live.fingerprintChanged: The configuration or agent has changed; the old snapshot is diagnostic only.
en.live.readonlyMode: Current mode: {mode} (the agent offers no switcher)
en.live.rebindConfirm: Confirm discard and reopen? DSH-side history is fully preserved; the agent's semantic context will be cleared and cannot be recovered.
en.live.staleBanner: Last-known snapshot; editable again after the next message resumes the agent.
en.live.switchCorrupt: The pending model switch record is corrupt: consistency cannot be proven and prompts are locked. Way out: discard the ACP context and reopen; or start a new session.

en.live.switchPendingStale: The last model switch ({previous} → {target}) did not complete; it will converge automatically once a message resumes the session.
en.live.switchUndecidable: The last model switch ({previous} → {target}) could not confirm its final state; prompts are locked. Way out: roll back to {previous}; or discard the ACP context and reopen.
en.live.unavailable: This agent does not expose session-level options.
